description: Install the app and manage what's stored for offline use

tutorial.title: How to install
tutorial.description: Steps for different devices and browsers
tutorial.benefitsHomeScreenDesc: Open it like any other app
tutorial.benefitsNotificationsDesc: Get updates like any other app
tutorial.chromeStep1: Look for the install icon in the address bar or a banner at the bottom
tutorial.chromeStep3: The app is added to your applications and home screen
tutorial.iosStep2: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen
tutorial.iosStep3: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
tutorial.iosStep4: Tap "Add" in the top right corner
tutorial.androidStep1: Open the app in Chrome or another supported browser
tutorial.androidStep2: Look for the "Add to Home Screen" banner or check the menu

contentManager.title: Offline content
contentManager.description: Download songs and manage them for offline use
contentManager.pwaRequiredDescription: Offline content can only be managed in the installed app. Install it first to use the offline features.
contentManager.downloadAllSongsToAccess: Download songs to use them without an internet connection
contentManager.downloadError: Download failed. Please check your connection and try again.
contentManager.assetCachingFailed: The song texts were saved, but not all sheet music and audio files could be stored. Your device is probably out of space. Free some up and download again.
contentManager.confirmClearContent: Clear all offline content? This frees up storage, but you'll have to download the songs again to use them offline.
contentManager.offlineContentCleared: All offline content has been cleared
contentManager.downloadIncompleteDescription: The lyrics are stored, but downloading the sheet music and sound files was interrupted. Run "Update content" before using the device offline.
